cards.name: Copper
cards.text: Provide 1 money.

cards.name: Silver
cards.text: Provide 2 money.

cards.name: Gold
cards.text: Provide 3 money.

cards.name: Focus
cards.text: Gain 1 mana.

cards.name: Channel
cards.text: Gain 1 mana. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Ley Step
cards.text: Move 1 space. Gain 1 mana. Gain 1 additional mana if you are at Far range after moving.

cards.name: Attune
cards.text: Gain 1 mana. Draw 1 card. Gain 1 additional mana for each other copy of Attune you played this turn.

cards.name: Prism
cards.text: Gain 2 mana. Draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

cards.name: Arc Bolt
cards.text: Spend 1 mana. Deal 4 damage at any range.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.text: Spend 2 mana. Deal 8 damage at any range.

cards.name: Starfire
cards.text: Spend 3 mana. Deal 12 damage at any range.

cards.name: Discharge
cards.text: Deal 2 damage at any range for each mana you have. Lose all mana.

cards.name: Cascade
cards.text: Spend 1 mana. Deal 4 damage at any range. Deal 2 additional damage for each other spell you played this turn.

cards.name: Overload
cards.text: Deal 2 damage at any range for each mana you spent this turn.

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: At Close range, draw 1 card. Each Close-range attack you make this turn deals 1 additional damage.

cards.name: Jab
cards.text: At Close range, deal 2 damage. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Strike
cards.text: At Close range, deal 3 damage.

cards.name: Drive
cards.text: At Close range, deal 3 damage. Then move both fighters 1 space so they remain Close. If a wall blocks the move, neither fighter moves and the attack deals 2 additional damage.

cards.name: Heavy Blow
cards.text: At Close range, deal 6 damage.

cards.name: Opening Strike
cards.text: At Close range, deal 4 damage if this is the first card you played this turn. Otherwise deal 1 damage.

cards.name: Rally
cards.text: At Close range, deal 1 damage. Deal 1 additional damage for each other copy of Rally you played this turn.

cards.name: Bull Rush
cards.text: At Close range, discard 1 Melee card: deal 5 damage.

cards.name: Flurry
cards.text: At Close range, deal 1 damage for each other Tactical Action played this turn.

cards.name: Aim
cards.text: At Near or Far range, draw 1 card. Add 2 damage to the next ranged attack you make this turn.

cards.name: Peppering Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 1 damage. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Steady Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 2 damage.

cards.name: Repelling Shot
cards.text: At Far range, deal 2 damage. At Near range, deal 1 damage. Move the opponent 1 space farther away. If they cannot move, move yourself 1 space farther away instead.

cards.name: Longshot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal damage equal to the distance between you and your opponent.

cards.name: Volley
cards.text: At Near range, deal 1 damage. At Far range, deal 4 damage.

cards.name: Salvage Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, discard 1 Ranged card: deal damage equal to its cost. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Precision Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 4 damage. Each other copy of Precision Shot you play this turn deals 2 damage instead.

cards.name: Step
cards.text: Move 1 space.

cards.name: Footwork
cards.text: You may move 1 space. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Stipend
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Provide 1 money.

cards.name: Reclaim
cards.text: Put 1 card from your discard pile into your hand. If your discard pile is empty, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Regroup
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Discard 1 card.

cards.name: Adapt
cards.text: Draw 1 card. If your position changed this turn, draw 1 more.

cards.name: Muster
cards.text: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Regiment
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Discipline
cards.text: Trash 1 card from your hand. Deal 1 damage at any range.

cards.name: Cull
cards.text: Trash 1 or 2 cards from your hand.

cards.name: Sharpen
cards.text: Draw 1 card. You may trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Reforge
cards.text: Trash 1 card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to 3 more than it.

cards.name: Scour
cards.text: Trash up to 2 cards from your hand. Draw 1 card for each card trashed.

cards.name: Improvise
cards.text: Deal 2 damage at any range for each different Mana, Melee, or Ranged family you played this turn.

cards.name: Scrap
cards.text: Deal 1 damage at any range.
